description: SEC auditor check — Who audits a US-listed company and whether that changed. Pass ticker= (or cik=), optional count= (1-5 annual reports, default 3). Reads the dei:AuditorName / AuditorFirmId (PCAOB ID) / AuditorLocation and ICFR-attestation XBRL tags from each 10-K/20-F/40-F, plus 8-K Item 4.01 (change in certifying accountant) filings. Returns the current auditor with a BIG 4 / NATIONAL / OTHER tier, per-report detail (fiscal year, filer category, shell flag), flags, and verdict STABLE / CHANGED / REVIEW / NO_DATA. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_auditor
